description: This file defines a GTK-based dialog class 'ProcessingActions' used for displaying and managing a processing actions dialog in a GUI application, including progress updates and action list visualization.

classes.name: ProcessingActions
classes.description: A GTK dialog class for processing actions, showing progress, and listing actions with icons.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the dialog, sets up UI components, and prepares the action list view.

methods.name: add_action_view
methods.description: Creates and returns the GTK TreeView widget and model for displaying actions.

methods.name: _set_applied_icon
methods.description: Sets an 'applied' icon on a specific action in the list based on position.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Starts the dialog and runs the GTK main loop.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Ends the progress, updates UI to indicate completion, and disables resizing.

methods.name: progress_msg
methods.description: Updates the progress message and icon based on current action index.
